Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso holds a press conference at the Manila City Hall on Wednesday, September 24, where he presented to the media the suspect accused of stabbing a 15-year-old minor during last Sunday’s violent protest. 

The 55-year-old suspect claimed he acted after his business was being attacked during the disturbance. The minor was rushed to a nearby hospital but was pronounced dead on arrival. (Photos by Mark Balmores/MB)
